A '''Starship Weapon''' is a [[Weapon]] subtype (printed '''Weapon — Starship'''). It deploys on a [[Starship]] and is used in battles at systems or sectors.

Do not confuse this with [[Starship]], the card type.

Other weapon subtypes: [[Character Weapon]], [[Automated Weapon]], [[Artillery Weapon]], [[Vehicle Weapon]].

Premiere examples: [[Proton Torpedoes]], [[Quad Laser Cannon]], [[Turbolaser Battery]], [[Boosted TIE Cannon]].
